headline: Revenue climbs year over year as losses deepen sharply
summary_short: Revenue of $191.2M was up 57.4% y/y but down 2.4% q/q; net loss widened to $64.5M from $28.6M in the prior quarter and $59.4M a year ago.
summary_long: Revenue was $191.2M, up 57.4% y/y but down 2.4% q/q. Gross margin held near 92%, similar to recent quarters. Diluted EPS was a loss of $1.26, widening from a $0.56 loss last quarter and a $1.22 loss a year ago. Net loss was $64.5M, versus $28.6M last quarter and $59.4M a year ago. Cash fell to $305.1M from $322.9M last quarter, roughly flat versus $300.9M a year ago.
